chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from the one whom he mentioned, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad al-ʿAlawī, from Dāwūd ibn al-Qāsim al-Jaʿfarī, who said:
I heard Abā al-Ḥasan al-ʿAskarī عليه السلام saying: “The successor after me is al-Ḥasan, so how will it be for you with the successor after the successor?”
So I said: “And why, may Allah make me your ransom?” He said: “You will not see his person, and it is not permissible for you to mention him by his name.”
So I said: “Then how should we mention him?” He said: “Say: the Ḥujjah from the family of Muḥammad, may Allah’s blessings and His peace be upon him.”

key_terms.آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْحُجَّةُ: the Divine Authority of Allah over creation
key_terms.الْخَلَفُ: the successor who comes after a preceding Imam

ai.seo_question: How should the believers refer to the hidden successor after Imam al-ʿAskarī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports from Abū al-Ḥasan al-ʿAskarī عليه السلام concerning the successor after the successor, indicating a later Imam whose person would not be seen openly. It also instructs the believers not to mention him by his personal name, but to refer to him as al-Ḥujjah from the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from the one who mentioned it, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad Al Alawy, from Dawood Al Qasim Al Ja’fary who said,

‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan Al-Askary<sup>asws</sup> (10<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) saying: ‘The replacement (Imam<sup>asws</sup>) from after me<sup>asws</sup> is Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, so how would it be for you all with the replacement (Imam<sup>asws</sup>) from after the replacement (Imam<sup>asws</sup>)?’

So I said, ‘And why? May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>!’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You all would not be seeing his<sup>asws</sup> person (physically), not would be Permissible for you all to mention him<sup>asws</sup> by his<sup>asws</sup> name’.

So I said, ‘So how should we mention him<sup>asws</sup>?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You should be saying, ‘The Divine Authority (Al-Hujjat) from the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from the person whose name he mentioned from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-‘Alawi from Dawud ibn al-Qasim al-Ja‘fari who has said the following.
“I heard abu al-Hassan al-‘Skari (a.s.) saying, ‘The succeeding Imam after me will be al-Hassan (a.s.). How will it be for you in the case of the succeeding Imam after the Imam succeeding myself?”

I then asked, “ May Allah take my souls in service for your cause, why will that be so?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “You will not see his person and it will not be permissible for you to mention his name.”
I then asked, “How then will we speak of him?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “Say, al-Hujja, (th Leader with Divine Authority) from the family of Muhammad (s.a).”
